item.title: Former actress puts Jester’s Cafe up for sale in Wilmington
item.description: A former actress and longtime Wilmington resident is selling her neighborhood cafe.

item.title: Therapy dogs bring stress relief to UNCW students
item.description: Some UNCW students are de-stressing with canine therapy.

item.title: Brunswick County man charged with murder in Supply shooting
item.description: A Bolivia man has been charged with murder following a shooting in Supply on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Wilmington board denies drive-through restaurant variance near Echo Farms
item.description: A proposed drive-through restaurant near a Wilmington neighborhood raised safety and traffic concerns among Echo Farms residents.

item.title: Captain David MacAlpine, a hero to many
item.description: Many in New Hanover County, and beyond, are wanting a bridge or road to honor the late Captain David MacAlpine.

item.title: Tariffs paid by midsize US companies tripled last year, a JPMorganChase Institute study shows
item.description: Tariffs paid by midsize U.S. businesses tripled over the course of past year, new research tied to one of America’s leading banks showed on Thursday — more evidence that President Donald Trump 's push to charge higher taxes on imports is causing economic disruption.

item.title: Reverse Card: UNCW storms back for 79-69 win over Monmouth
item.description: While it may be a different game, how UNCW men's basketball defeated Monmouth 79-69 on Thursday is nothing new.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria’ star, dies at 53 after being diagnosed with ALS
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became an advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Pender County Commissioners approve $10.8 million budget, $7.9 million contract for new Hampstead Library
item.description: In a four-to-one vote, Pender County Commissioners this week approved several items related to the new Hampstead branch library.

item.title: Holly Ridge approves annexation of 1200 plus acres for new development, including 300 acres in Pender County
item.description: The annexation was requested as part of a proposed 2,700-plus unit housing development.
